queries: Altman "we are not gonna deploy AGI next month, nor have we built it"

sources_considered.why: Dated news report that embeds and quotes Altman's 20 January 2025 X post and contrasts it with his 5 January blog post.
Independent dated report of the same Altman statement.
Duplicate coverage; two reports were enough.

receipt.public_excerpt: "Twitter hype is out of control again," Altman posted on X Monday, pulling back from weeks of cryptic teasers and bold predictions about the company's latest AI model, o3. "We are not gonna deploy AGI next month, nor have we built it."

evidence_items.explanation: Shows that on 20 January 2025 Altman publicly said OpenAI had not built AGI and would not deploy it next month, which plays down the closeness he had suggested.

receipt.public_excerpt: Such statements seem like a sharp U-turn from Altman's recent blog post where he claimed OpenAI knew how to build AGI

evidence_items.explanation: An independent outlet read the 20 January post the same way Marcus did: as a reversal of the 5 January message.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI won't be deploying artificial general intelligence (AGI) next month, nor have they built it yet, Altman writes, pushing back against the mounting speculation about OpenAI's next moves. "We have some very cool stuff for you but pls chill and cut your expectations 100x!"

evidence_items.explanation: A second dated report confirms that Altman told people to cut their expectations 100x and said AGI had not been built.

unresolved_gaps: Altman's X post itself could not be read directly; it is cited through news reports that quote it word for word.
The post did not explicitly withdraw the 5 January sentence that OpenAI knows how to build AGI.
